主要内容: On March 19, 2015, Insperity, Inc. announced that its board of directors had extended the deadline for Starboard Value LP and its affiliated entities to nominate directors and propose other business for consideration at the 2015 annual meeting. The extension was from March 19, 2015, to March 23, 2015. Any nominations or proposals received by the company from Starboard by the close of business on March 23, 2015, and complying with the company’s bylaws, may be submitted to stockholders at the 2015 annual meeting. This extension was specific to Starboard and applicable only for the 2015 annual meeting of stockholders.
